item.note: Invitation only. Doors open 17:30 CET. Roman Przibylla and Dominic Weibel on the market outlook, and Pernilla van der Capellen (Aspia) on Swedish tax treatment of digital assets, then drinks in the vault. Attendance is by invitation from Bitcoin Suisse.
